entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... I see an order here for the VeloFit Aero-Dynamic Helmet. Is that the item you're calling about?
Okay. And just so I can properly document this for you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is not what I expected. It looked different on the website.
I understand completely. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be a bit deceiving. Just to confirm for the return, is the item still in new condition?
The box is unopened. I haven't even taken it out.

Perfect, thank you for clarifying. I'm looking at the delivery date, and I see it arrived 70 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now.

Alright, I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on your account. You'll just need to print that out and attach it to the shipping box. To ensure the safety of the product during shipping, please make sure it's securely packaged.
Whatever. When do I get the refund?

Once our warehouse receives and inspects the helmet, your refund will be issued to the original form of payment. You can typically expect to see it within 5 to 7 business days from when we receive the package. Was there anything else for you today?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
